column_description: TEXT. Unique identifier for archeologys project registration. PK = Projects(ArcRegistry). Example: PR7509.
TEXT. Project name or designation label. Example: Project Happy.
TEXT. Source of project funding or financial backing. Possible values: Government, Grant, Private, University.
TEXT. Official permit or authorization number for excavation. Example: PMT4719.
TEXT. Permit expiration date or authorization termination date. Example: 05/12/2025.
